blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No bettor won the P575.94 million Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot or the P126.81 million Super Lotto 6/49 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Sunday, Nov. 22, 2026. According to the PCSO results, the Ultra Lotto 6/58 draw produced the winning combination 05-51-44-55-32-21, with a jackpot prize of P575.94
